items.name: Yangtze
facts: Longest river in Asia.
Called the Chang Jiang in China.
Empties into the East China Sea at Shanghai.

items.name: Yellow River
items.fact: China’s Huang He; “cradle of Chinese civilization.”
facts: China’s Huang He; “cradle of Chinese civilization.”
China’s second-longest river.
Named for the loess silt it carries.

items.name: Amur
items.fact: Border river of China and Russia.
facts: Border river of China and Russia.
Known in China as the Heilong Jiang.
Reaches the Tatar Strait near the Sea of Okhotsk.

items.name: Pearl River
facts: Principal river of southern China.
Its delta includes Guangzhou, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong.

items.name: Yalu
items.fact: Border river of China and North Korea.
facts: Border river of China and North Korea.
Empties into Korea Bay.

items.name: Han River
facts: Principal river of Seoul.
Flows through the Korean Peninsula to the Yellow Sea.

items.name: Liao River
facts: Principal river of southern Manchuria.
Empties into the Bohai Sea.

items.name: Songhua
items.fact: Largest tributary of the Amur in China.
facts: Largest tributary of the Amur in China.
Flows through Harbin.

items.name: Qinghai Lake
facts: Largest lake in China.
A saline lake on the Tibetan Plateau.

items.name: Poyang Lake
facts: China’s largest freshwater lake (when full).
On the Yangtze floodplain in Jiangxi.

items.name: Dongting Lake
facts: A major Yangtze flood-basin lake.
In Hunan, south of the river.

items.name: Lake Khanka
facts: Largest lake in Northeast Asia.
Straddles the China–Russia border.

items.name: Lake Biwa
facts: Largest lake in Japan.
Near Kyoto in Shiga Prefecture.

items.name: Hulun Lake
items.fact: One of China’s largest steppe lakes.
facts: One of China’s largest steppe lakes.
In Inner Mongolia, near the Russian border.

items.name: Pacific Ocean
items.fact: Ocean east of China, Korea, and Japan.
facts: Ocean east of China, Korea, and Japan.

items.name: East China Sea
items.fact: Between China, Korea, and the Ryukyu Islands.
facts: Between China, Korea, and the Ryukyu Islands.

items.name: Yellow Sea
items.fact: Between China and the Korean Peninsula.
facts: Between China and the Korean Peninsula.

items.name: Sea of Japan
facts: Between Japan and the mainland.
Also called the East Sea.

items.name: South China Sea
items.fact: The southern sea of East Asia’s rim.
facts: The southern sea of East Asia’s rim.

items.name: Taiwan Strait
facts: Between mainland China and Taiwan.

items.name: Korea Strait
facts: Between Korea and Japan.
Links the East China Sea to the Sea of Japan.

items.name: Tsugaru Strait
facts: Between Honshu and Hokkaido.
The main strait of northern Japan.

items.name: Bohai Sea
items.fact: Innermost gulf of the Yellow Sea.
facts: Innermost gulf of the Yellow Sea.
Beijing and Tianjin sit on its rim.

items.name: Tokyo Bay
facts: Bay on Japan’s Pacific coast.
Tokyo, Yokohama, and Chiba ring its shores.
